title: Clerey inspect report leaking beat_dburi password
body:
Celery Inspect report obscures some passwords from the worker report (I.E. broker url, result_backend) but it is not obscuring passwords from "beat_dburi". As a result this shows in Flower UI under the config section. ![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/1c483e67-6d4b-457e-9621-4b54caede7d2) ![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/410a0377-9936-48c6-99c7-908860e66bd3) # Proposed solutions Add "beat_dburi" here https://github.com/celery/celery/blob/main/celery/app/utils.py#L338 ` elif 'backend' in key.lower() or 'beat_dburi' in key.lower():` or Add '|DBURI' or '|BEAT_DBURI' here https://github.com/celery/celery/blob/main/celery/app/utils.py#L38 `HIDDEN_SETTINGS = re.compile( 'API|TOKEN|KEY|SECRET|PASS|PROFANITIES_LIST|SIGNATURE|DATABASE|DBURI', re.IGNORECASE, )` # Checklist - [x] I have verified that the issue exists against the `main` branch of Celery. - [ ] This has already been asked to the [discussions forum](https://github.com/celery/celery/discussions) first. - [x] I have read the relevant section in the [contribution guide](https://docs.celeryq.dev/en/main/contributing.html#other-bugs) on reporting bugs. - [x] I have checked the [issues list](https://github.com/celery/celery/issues?q=is%3Aissue+label%3A%22Issue+Type%3A+Bug+Report%22+-label%3A%22Category%3A+Documentation%22) for similar or identical bug reports. - [x] I have checked the [pull requests list](https://github.com/celery/celery/pulls?q=is%3Apr+label%3A%22PR+Type%3A+Bugfix%22+-label%3A%22Category%3A+Documentation%22) for existing proposed fixes. - [x] I have checked the [commit log](https://github.com/celery/celery/commits/main) to find out if the bug was already fixed in the main branch. - [x] I have included all related issues and possible duplicate issues in this issue (If there are none, check this box anyway). - [ ] I have tried to reproduce the issue with [pytest-celery](https://docs.celeryq.dev/projects/pytest-celery/en/latest/userguide/celery-bug-report.html) and added the reproduction script below. ## Mandatory Debugging Information - [x] I have included the output of ``celery -A proj report`` in the issue. (if you are not able to do this, then at least specify the Celery version affected). - [x] I have verified that the issue exists against the `main` branch of Celery. - [x] I have included the contents of ``pip freeze`` in the issue. - [x] I have included all the versions of all the external dependencies required to reproduce this bug. ## Related Issues and Possible Duplicates #### Related Issues - None #### Possible Duplicates - None ## Environment & Settings **Celery version**: $ celery --version 5.4.0 (opalescent)
celery report Output:

``` report: software -> celery:5.4.0 (opalescent) kombu:5.4.2 py:3.11.11 billiard:4.2.1 redis:4.6.0 platform -> system:Linux arch:64bit, ELF kernel version:6.8.0-52-generic imp:CPython loader -> celery.loaders.app.AppLoader (I cannot show more, but in this report the "beat_dburi" value is repaced with *******) ```

## Minimally Reproducible Test Case

```python app = Celery( APP_NAME, broker=config.get_broker_uri(), backend=config.get_backend_uri(), include=[TASKS_PATH], ) app.conf.update( result_expires=config.RESULT_EXPIRES, result_extended=True, beat_dburi=config.get_beat_uri(), timezone="UTC" ) # run the app workers # run celery -A proj inspect report ```

# Expected Behavior The worker report should hide the password for the "beat_dburi" connection string. # Actual Behavior The worker report shows clear password for the "beat_dburi" (see images) Because the inspect report returns a clear password, that also shows in Flower ui in the worker config.
